title: Seldon case (frontmatter + derived fields as they appear in the index)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of work/*/C-*.md (where `type: case` appears) and the case objects in index.cases (where path, steps and proposedEvents are added by the engine).

type.description: frontmatter only (SPEC-LOGBOOK §3); omitted in the index

events.description: ids of non-seldon ledger events attributed to this case (directly or via a linked resolution), oldest first

path.description: index only: relative to logbook root

steps.description: index only: checkboxes in the case's ## Plan section

proposedEvents.description: index only: open drift events the engine thinks belong here

intent.description: index only: the first paragraph of ## Intent (after an imported case's provenance line), without direction and format characters, redacted, clipped to 256 bytes of JSON with the marker '… (N more characters in the file)' (ADR-0038 §2)

result.description: index only: the first paragraph of ## Result, as intent (ADR-0038 §2)

source.description: an imported case's task: ~/…/file.md#line or ~/…/file.md, redacted, at most 512 bytes (UTF-8) as well; written by `seldon import task` into the frontmatter and copied to the index; display only, never an argument (ADR-0038 §3)
